benchmark: PhiC31 pseudo-attP learned predictor, full Chalberg 2006 115-site genomic set (O-G2 / P3)
question: Does a learned model over sequence/architecture features recover the documented human phiC31 genomic pseudo-attP sites above BOTH (a) canonical-attP sequence-similarity and (b) the palindrome-only feature, on a by-chromosome held-out split?

provenance.note: Every value in this file is copied verbatim from the sealed P3 result set produced 2026-07-04 on the VM (penstack:phase1.5). This file redistributes those pre-registered, sealed numbers into the pen-stack benchmark tree; it performs no new computation. The pre-registration was sealed BEFORE feature-scoring/fitting and run once (not retuned).

honest_reading.strict_sealed_rule: learned_model_validated required beating BOTH baselines on BOTH AUROC and AUPRC with the bootstrap 95% CI of each difference excluding 0 (N>=30, by-chromosome CV). The model does NOT clear this bar because it does not improve AUROC over attP-similarity (AUROC diff CI [-0.0537, 0.0651] includes 0). Sealed verdict: learned_model_null.
honest_reading.precision_recall_gain: On AUPRC, the operationally-relevant rare-positive retrieval metric (prevalence 0.0491), the learned model beats BOTH baselines with CI excluding 0: AUPRC 0.2154 vs 0.0944 (attP-similarity) and 0.0548 (palindrome), roughly 2-4x the baselines and >4x prevalence.
honest_reading.what_the_null_teaches: At proper power (N=115, GC-matched genomic negatives) canonical-attP sequence similarity is itself a moderate predictor (AUROC 0.6317). So the earlier N=3 open-subset conclusion that sequence identity sits below chance does NOT generalize to the well-powered set; identity carries real ranking signal, and the learned model matches (not beats) it on AUROC while improving precision.
honest_reading.caveat_gc_only_decoys: Negatives are GC-matched genomic windows, a relatively easy decoy. A stronger test would use dinucleotide/k-mer-composition-matched or accessibility-matched decoys, or a genome-wide FDR. The AUPRC win is method-comparative separability, not an in-vivo integration-rate model or a genome-wide FDR.
honest_reading.reported_as: A truthful negative on the strict both-metrics criterion together with a genuine, CI-clean precision-recall gain. Run once, not retuned.
